brief: When something needs a real terminal, ask for it with `vs-shell run [--cwd DIR] [--label TEXT] -- COMMAND…`: the user runs or declines it from its card.

commands.about: vs-shell run [--cwd DIR] [--label TEXT] -- COMMAND…: asks the user for a shell session running COMMAND
commands.name: vs-shell

plugins.summary: An agent asks for a new shell session running a command it names; nothing runs until you answer its card run in your terminal.
plugins.title: Shell requests
